issues.on_page: Interest 1,399 in the Schedule of County Treasurer Activity (General Levy column, under Revenues Collected with the tax lines)

amortization is a non-cash bond-related item (premium/discount/refunding), not interest paid; classing it as debt service interest is a judgment call (same for detail lines Amortization 820 p9 and 1,304 p11)
